final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT e.ordersmark AS ordersmark, o.orderflow AS orderflow, AVG(e.fillcount) AS avgfill FROM orderexecutions e JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = e.ordersmark WHERE e.expirespot >= '2025-02-28 08:29:46.10496' AND e.expirespot <= '2025-03-13 08:29:46.068533' GROUP BY e.ordersmark, o.orderflow) SELECT AVG(avgfill) FROM s1
